verdict.rationale: Google's own Data API docs point users to an official MCP server for Google Analytics, installable from GitHub. The probe confirms it lives in the official googleanalytics GitHub org (google-analytics-mcp), so agents can connect through a first-party MCP server. missing for 10: documentation of exposed tools/scope (reporting vs admin operations), setup/auth details, clarity on GA status (the "Try" framing suggests preview), independent or hands-on corroboration.
